title: BlacklistConfig hardcoded default in PeeringShared — operator cannot configure it
description: session.rs PeeringShared is constructed in main.rs with blacklist_config: BlacklistConfig::default() (failure_threshold=10, duration_secs=3600). There is no config.toml field for these values. An operator who wants tighter blacklisting (e.g. 3 failures) cannot configure it without recompiling. The BlacklistConfig values should be read from the [peering] section of the config.
